paragraphs.text: Rogelio Anzures Tapia participated in Founding of Bruma del Cobre on 2010-03-14. Bruma del Cobre was linked to Founding of Bruma del Cobre on 2010-03-14. Founding of Bruma del Cobre occurred at Manzanillo on 2010-03-14. A cooperating defendant with prior access to the Manzanillo waterfront described the event as the moment three separate stevedore crews stopped competing for container slots and began answering to one man. Anzures, a former customs broker whom dock workers had long called El Portuario, had spent the preceding year buying the loyalty of crane operators and yard clerks with cash and with promises of steady work. The source stated that the crews agreed to pool their access to the container terminal so that inbound chemical shipments could be routed through a single set of trusted hands.

Gilberto Tinoco Arzate participated in Founding of Bruma del Cobre on 2010-03-14. Abundio Lira Castañeda participated in Founding of Bruma del Cobre on 2010-03-14. Rogelio Anzures Tapia used DEMO-ACCT-00230 on 2010-03-14. The source identified Tinoco, known on the docks as El Grúa, as the person who managed crane schedules and arranged for selected containers to be moved before inspection. Lira, called El Yunque by the crews, was described as the enforcer whose presence ended the arguments over territory inside the yard. The account identifier was described by the source as the one Anzures used to settle payments to yard staff during the first weeks of the arrangement. The source has not seen the account records directly and reported the identifier from memory.

Bruma del Cobre controlled Manzanillo port plaza from 2010-03-14 until 2014-08-02. Rogelio Anzures Tapia led Bruma del Cobre from 2010-03-14 until 2014-08-02. Rogelio Anzures Tapia was a member of Bruma del Cobre from 2010-03-14 until 2014-08-02. The reporting office assesses that the source's account of leadership is consistent with other reporting on the network. The source characterized Anzures as cautious and reluctant to be seen with the crews outside the terminal. No information was provided on the volume of material moved during the first months. The source will remain in contact with the reporting office and additional detail on the yard arrangements is expected.
